verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a workflow-automation platform, but the evidence describes Make only as a cloud service. Its API and test runner target Make-operated production zones (eu1/eu2/us1/us2.make.com). The on-prem agents endpoint is an adjacent connectivity feature and does not show that the core product can be self-hosted.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
